annotations.target_phrase: Preparatory to anything else Mr Bloom brushed off the dust from Stephen's clothes.
annotations.annotation_text: Opening of Part III (The Nostos) and Episode 16 (Eumaeus). 1:00 AM. Leopold Bloom guides an exhausted, shaken Stephen Dedalus to the cabman's shelter under Loopline Bridge near Custom House Quay. Written in an intentionally fatigued, cliché-laden, and circumlocutory prose style reflecting somatic physical exhaustion.
sources: Gilbert, Stuart. James Joyce's Ulysses: A Study. Faber, 1930.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 534.

annotations.annotation_text: James Fitzharris (1833–1910), nicknamed 'Skin-the-Goat', driver of the getaway cab in the 1882 Phoenix Park Murders of Lord Frederick Cavendish and Thomas Henry Burke. He runs the cabman's shelter, embodying unrepentant Fenian physical force nationalism.
sources: Corballis, Richard. Joyce and the Phoenix Park Murders. 2004.
Gifford, Don. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988.
